meta.title: Shamel Pro Web API - endpoint catalogue and capability matrix
meta.source: ISCO 'Shamel Pro API Manual' (20 pp.; pp. 2-3 Arabic), cross-checked with docs/upstream/shamel-api.md; Bawaba routes from docs/design/03-api.md section 6/7; open questions from docs/design/08-isco-questions.md
meta.page_refs: page = first PDF page of the endpoint; pages = full range
meta.path_rule: path is normalized with a leading slash; path_as_printed is exactly as in the manual

meaning_source_legend.manual: stated in English in the manual
meaning_source_legend.manual-ar: stated in an Arabic comment or heading in the manual (English translation given, Arabic kept)
meaning_source_legend.inferred: reasonable reading of names/types/structure, not stated

conventions.style: RPC-style /{Controller}/{Action} paths; the vendor calls it "restful web API" (p. 4)
conventions.base_url: undocumented: no scheme, host, port, base path or version (ISCO-07)
conventions.auth: POST /Main/Login with form username + password returns a token; every other request must send request headers username and token (p. 4)
conventions.errors: "any error occurred the service will return Http error 500 with the error details" (p. 4); writes can also report Success=false in the body (pp. 9, 15, 19) (ISCO-18, ISCO-19)
conventions.dates: "Date format is always yyyy-MM-dd" (p. 4); VoucherHeader.time is hhmmss (p. 13)
conventions.read_inputs: custom request headers, never the query string; GetVouchers/GetExtraVouchers put a JSON object in the filters header
conventions.write_inputs: one form field ("post parameter") holding a JSON string: obj, or filters on the cost-center report; only Login states x-www-form-urlencoded (ISCO-16)
conventions.responses: C# class declarations only; JSON stated only for write results ("as Json"); wire casing and nulls unverified (ISCO-17)
conventions.pagination: none on any endpoint; lists return everything in one response; only GetCurrencyRates has a fixed limit (10) (ISCO-21)
conventions.incremental_sync: lastupdatedate header on 3 endpoints only (GetCustomers, GetItems, GetItemsStores); date-only (ISCO-22)
conventions.methods: the manual names no HTTP method; 'post parameter' implies POST for 7 endpoints, the other 23 are assumed GET (ISCO-12)
conventions.writes: insert-only: no update, delete, cancel or void endpoint for any entity; no idempotency (ISCO-43, ISCO-55)

endpoints.purpose: Log a Shamel user in and get the session token that every other call must carry.
endpoints.method_basis: "You must put the following info in post parameter (x-www-form-urlencoded)" (p. 4)

inputs.name: username
inputs.meaning: Shamel login name; p. 2 calls it user number (رقم المستخدم)

inputs.name: password
inputs.meaning: the user's password (كلمة المرور, p. 2)

listed_in_overview.ar: Token: you could have it by call login method
listed_in_overview.en: security section: user number, password and token are required for any operation

notes: "Keep the token to send it with every request" (p. 4); later calls send headers username + token, never the password.
Token lifetime, expiry, refresh, logout and the effect of a second login are undocumented (ISCO-01, ISCO-02).
How a failed login is reported (HTTP 500 or success=false) is undocumented; whether a user with userIsDisabled=true still gets a token is unknown (ISCO-03).
salesmanCode binds the user to a salesman; this drives the salesman scoping of /Customer/GetCustomers (getAll) and /Voucher/GetDelivery (inferred from pp. 7, 16; ISCO-25).
HTTPS is not mentioned anywhere, so the password may cross the network in clear text (ISCO-05).
endpoints.bawaba_route: not exposed (used only by Bawaba's session manager; /legacy/Main/Login is refused)

endpoints.purpose: List all currencies defined in Shamel.
notes: "Get all currencies" (p. 4). No filter.
units and division are undocumented (ISCO-28).
Other endpoints refer to a currency by a code string such as "NIS" or "$" (VoucherHeader.currency, p. 13), not by id; codes are not ISO 4217.

endpoints.purpose: Get the latest 10 exchange rates.
notes: "Get latest 10 currency rate" (p. 5): fixed limit, no currency or date filter, so historical rates or the rate on a given date cannot be read.
Whether 10 means 10 in total or 10 per currency is not stated (ISCO-28).
is_base meaning undocumented (inferred: base/local currency flag). Type printed as String (capital S).

endpoints.purpose: List all banks.
notes: "Get All Banks" (p. 5). No filter.
Bank.code is what VoucherCheqs.bank_code refers to (p. 14, comment رقم البنك).

endpoints.purpose: List all bank branches.
notes: "Get all branchs" [sic] (p. 5). The path itself is misspelled (Branchs) and must be called as printed.
No filter by bank: all branches come back; bank_code links a branch to Bank.code (inferred).
VoucherCheqs.branch_code refers to it (p. 14, comment رقم فرع البنك).

endpoints.purpose: List all cities.
notes: "Get all cities" (p. 6).
Customer.city, Customer(write).City and VoucherHeader.city are int ids referring to City.id (inferred from types).
Towns/villages (Customer.town, write field Town = كود القرية, village code) have no list endpoint.

endpoints.purpose: List all stores (warehouses).
endpoints.returns: list of Store (the manual prints the class name as "City")
notes: "Get all stores" (p. 6), but the structure is printed as "class City" (copy-paste error).
type values are undocumented; car_code suggests some stores are vehicles for van sales (inferred); orgnization_code [sic] undocumented (ISCO-27, ISCO-49).
Store.id is referenced by ItemStore.store, VoucherItems.store, VoucherHeader.order_store and the store header of /Item/GetItems.

endpoints.purpose: Get the names of the 6 price classes.
notes: "Get the 6 price classes name" (p. 6).
Price class N is presumably Item.sale_pariceN and Customer.price_class = N (inferred; ISCO-29). Customer.price_class is typed double while PriceClass.id is int.

endpoints.purpose: Presumably lists salesmen; the manual prints only the heading.
endpoints.inputs_note: undocumented: the manual prints only the heading (p. 6)
notes: Heading only (p. 6): no description, no inputs, no response model. Kind "read" is inferred from the name.
Salesman codes appear in AuthResult.salesmanCode (p. 4), Customer.salesman_code (p. 7), Customer(write).Salesman (p. 9) and VoucherHeader.salesman (p. 13).
Needs an ISCO answer or a live capture before use (ISCO-26).

endpoints.purpose: List customers (by default only the logged-in salesman's), optionally only those changed since a date, with optional balances, classifications and contacts.

inputs.name: lastupdatedate
inputs.meaning: only customers updated after this date (yyyy-MM-dd); empty = all customers. "Get all customers if lastupdatedate is empty , if not get all customers that updated after lastupdatedate"

inputs.name: code
inputs.meaning: "to get one customer with the filled “code”" (the result is still a list)

inputs.name: vatreg
inputs.meaning: "to filter on vatreg field" (the field is VATReg, VAT registration number)

inputs.name: getBalance
inputs.meaning: "true" returns the customer's current balance, not-paid cheques balance and returned cheques balance (fills balance, notPayedCheqsBalance, returnedCheqsBalance)

inputs.name: getStopped
inputs.meaning: "true" returns ONLY stopped customers

inputs.name: getClassifications
inputs.meaning: "true" returns customer classifications (fills classifications)

inputs.name: getContacts
inputs.meaning: "true" returns customer's contacts (fills contacts)

inputs.name: getAll
inputs.meaning: true returns all customers, "even not the salesman's customers"; without it the list is limited to the logged-in user's salesman

endpoints.returns: list of Customer (read model: 31 scalar fields + classifications + contacts lists)
notes: Salesman scoping is implicit: "To get all customers even not the salesman's customers fill Header["getAll"]=true" (p. 7). Behaviour for a user with no salesman link is unknown (ISCO-25).
getStopped returns only stopped customers; whether the default (no header) includes stopped customers is not stated (ISCO-30).
Balance fields are filled only with getBalance="true"; their value otherwise is not stated (inferred 0) (ISCO-31).

lastupdatedate is date-only (global yyyy-MM-dd rule, p. 4); 'after' may be exclusive, timezone not stated, deletions not reported, and balance changes probably do not count as updates (ISCO-22, ISCO-23).
No name search, no paging, no count: the full (scoped) list comes back in one response (ISCO-21).
Matching rules for code and vatreg (exact, prefix, case) are not stated (ISCO-15).
Undocumented field meanings: citizen_code, attr, man_name, trans_permissions, creditType, level, discount (ISCO-32, ISCO-49). credit_limit and balance are sensitive.
Boolean headers printed as "true" (quoted) except getAll (unquoted true); other spellings untested (ISCO-14).

endpoints.purpose: Get the balances of one customer (by code or VAT number), or of all customers.

inputs.name: customerCode
inputs.meaning: customer code; "if customerCode is empty it will return all customers balances"

inputs.name: vatreg
inputs.meaning: "Fill Header[vatreg] if you want to get customer by vatreg."

notes: Header names printed without quotes (Header[customerCode], Header[vatreg]) (p. 8).
One row per customer per currency is inferred from the currency field; pos, date and rate are undocumented (ISCO-31).
Whether this endpoint is salesman-scoped is not stated (ISCO-25).
No balance history and no as-of-date parameter; balance at a voucher's time is only available via getCustomerBalance on the voucher reads (p. 17).

endpoints.purpose: Insert a new customer; Shamel assigns and returns the new customer code.
endpoints.method_basis: "You must put the customer info in post parameter with key name [obj]" (p. 8)

inputs.name: obj
inputs.meaning: "obj string must be in Json format of the following class": Customer (write model)

fields.name: VatReg
fields.meaning: customer's licensed-dealer / VAT registration number (مشتغل مرخص الزبون)

fields.name: Address
fields.meaning: street (الشارع); printed without // before the comment

fields.name: MobileNumber
fields.meaning: commented as fax (فاكس), contradicting the field name

fields.name: Salesman
fields.meaning: default salesman; leave empty if there are no salesmen (المندوب الافتراضي – في حال عدم وجود مندوبين لا يتم تعبئته)

notes: "Insert new customer" (p. 8). "If the process succeeded, the value will contain the inserted code of the customer" (p. 9): the code is assigned by Shamel; there is no code field in the write model.
Insert only: no update or delete endpoint exists for customers.
The write model has no currency, credit limit, discount, GPS, contacts or classifications; defaults are unknown (ISCO-48).
Write names (PascalCase) differ from read names (snake_case); mapping is inferred only (ISCO-32).
Requiredness of individual fields is not stated. Duplicate detection (e.g. same VatReg) is unknown, and there is no idempotency: a retried call may create a duplicate (ISCO-43).
Failures may arrive as HTTP 500 or as Success=false with ErrorMessage (single string) (ISCO-19). Whether salesman scoping applies to writes is unknown (ISCO-25).

endpoints.purpose: Presumably returns customer- or price-class-specific item prices and discounts as rows; the manual states no purpose.
endpoints.purpose_source: inferred (from the name and fields; the manual only says "Return the following object")
endpoints.inputs_note: none documented, so it cannot be narrowed to a customer or item (ISCO-33)
endpoints.returns: unnamed price-row object, presumably a list (manual: "Return the following object")
notes: Path printed without a leading slash (p. 16); assumed to be /Customer/GetCustomerPricesAsRows (ISCO-13).
No inputs documented: presumably every row for every customer in one call (ISCO-21, ISCO-33).
stock_code is presumably the item code; code, discount_type values and tax (rate or amount) are undocumented (ISCO-33, ISCO-49).
Not listed in the p. 2 capability overview. Prices and discounts are commercially sensitive.

endpoints.purpose: List items (all, or only those changed since a date), optionally filtered by item code, serial, store or model.

inputs.name: lastupdatedate
inputs.meaning: only items updated after this date (yyyy-MM-dd); empty = all items. "Get all items if lastupdatedate is empty , if not get all items that updated after lastupdatedate"

inputs.name: serial
inputs.meaning: "to get items with this serial only"

inputs.name: itemCode
inputs.meaning: "to get items with this itemCode only"

inputs.name: store
inputs.meaning: "to get items with this store only" (Store.id); whether it means items stocked in or linked to the store is not stated

inputs.name: model
inputs.meaning: "to get items with this model only"; the read model has no model field (inferred: the numeric model id of /Item/Post)

notes: Field names kept as printed, including sale_parice1..6, orginal_code and orgnization_code (pp. 9-10).
Sensitive fields come back to every caller: purchase_price, credit_account, debit_account (p. 10).
No name or barcode search and no paging (ISCO-21). Matching rules for filters are not stated (ISCO-15).
Semantics of store and model filters are unclear (ISCO-35). Difference between sale_pariceN and unit_price_N, and meaning of currN, are undocumented (ISCO-29).
lastupdatedate has the same unknowns as on GetCustomers: date-only, exclusivity, timezone, no deletions (ISCO-22). Salesman scoping not stated (ISCO-25).

endpoints.purpose: Get stock quantities per item per store, for all items or one item.

inputs.name: lastupdatedate
inputs.meaning: listed ("Fill Headers[lastupdatedate]") but not explained; presumably only rows changed after this date, as on GetItems

inputs.name: itemcode
inputs.meaning: "to get item by code" (all lower-case, unlike itemCode elsewhere)

notes: "Get all items quantities" (p. 10).
No store filter: all stores come back (ISCO-36).
What lastupdatedate filters here (e.g. stock movements) is not stated (ISCO-22).
qnty is presumably in main_unit; zero/negative rows and reserved quantities are not explained (ISCO-36).
Header casing differs from other item endpoints (itemcode vs itemCode vs ItemCode) (ISCO-13).

endpoints.purpose: Get one item together with its quantities in each store.
endpoints.purpose_source: inferred (from the ItemDetails structure; the manual gives no description)

inputs.name: itemCode
inputs.meaning: item code of the item to fetch ("Fill Headers[itemCode]")

endpoints.returns: ItemDetails (manual says "It return list of this structure", but the shape is one item + its stock rows)

listed_in_overview.en: pull quantities of a specific item ([sic] كمات for كميات); mapping to this endpoint is inferred

notes: The action name is printed with a lower-case g (p. 11); routing is presumably case-insensitive (ISCO-13).
Decode both a single object and an array, since the manual says "list" for a single-object shape.
itm is the full Item read model, including purchase_price and GL accounts.

endpoints.purpose: List item groups (a tree via parent codes).
endpoints.purpose_source: inferred (manual only says "It return list of the following structure")
notes: Comment on code: "Item has itemGroupCode field that refer to this field" (p. 11), but the Item field is actually item_group_code; the parent link is parentCode here and item_group_father_code in Item (ISCO-35).
level is presumably the depth in the tree (inferred). Not listed in the p. 2 overview.

endpoints.purpose: List the image path of every item (the item catalogue).
notes: "Get all items image" (p. 11). No item filter.
image_path format is undocumented (URL, local path or UNC path) and may reveal the Shamel server; no endpoint returns image bytes (ISCO-34).

endpoints.purpose: List serial-numbered item units, optionally for one customer or one serial number.

inputs.name: customer
inputs.meaning: "to get serials with this customer code only"

inputs.name: serial
inputs.meaning: "to get serials with this serial code only"

notes: "Get all items with serials only" (p. 11).
No item-code filter. status values are undocumented (ISCO-49). start_grantee_date / end_grantee_date are misspellings of guarantee (warranty dates).
Serials cannot be written: VoucherItems.serials is "not used" (غير مستخدم, p. 14). Not listed in the p. 2 overview.

endpoints.purpose: Insert a new item with a caller-chosen code, one main unit and one price.
endpoints.method_basis: "You must put the Item info in post parameter with key name [obj]" (p. 19)

inputs.name: obj
inputs.meaning: "obj string must be in Json format of the following class": Item (write model)

fields.name: group
fields.meaning: belongs to group (تابع لصنف), i.e. the item group code (inferred)

fields.name: trademark
fields.meaning: trademark / brand (العلامة التجارية); no lookup endpoint

fields.name: producing_company
fields.meaning: producing company (الشركة المنتجة); no lookup endpoint

fields.name: note
fields.meaning: item note (printed ملاحظة النصف, a typo for ملاحظة الصنف)

notes: "Insert new Item" (p. 19). Insert only: no update or delete endpoint for items.
Unlike Customer/Post, the manual does not say what value contains (inferred: the item code) (ISCO-48).
Only unit1 and price1 can be set: units 2-6, prices 2-6, purchase price and GL accounts cannot be written.
trademark, producing_company, style and model are write-only ints whose valid values cannot be read (ISCO-48, ISCO-49).
Write names differ from read names: original_code vs orginal_code, price1 vs sale_parice1, group vs item_group_code, currency vs curr1..6.
Duplicate-code behaviour and idempotency are unknown (ISCO-43).

endpoints.purpose: Last-prices report for an item: recent transaction dates, prices, quantities and customers.
endpoints.purpose_source: manual-ar (title تقرير اخر الأسعار, last prices report, p. 3); row meaning inferred

inputs.name: ItemCode
inputs.meaning: item code; "ItemCode is mandatory"

inputs.name: barcode
inputs.meaning: item barcode; the manual prints "ItemCode is optional" after this line, presumably meaning barcode is optional

notes: Self-contradiction on p. 12: "ItemCode is mandatory" then "ItemCode is optional" after the barcode line (ISCO-37).
No customer filter: unclear whether it is global or per customer, and whether customer holds a code or a name (ISCO-37).
code is presumably the voucher code; included voucher types and row count are not stated. ItemCode is capitalised, unlike itemCode elsewhere (ISCO-13).

endpoints.purpose: Account statement (debits, credits, running balance) for a customer over a date range.
endpoints.purpose_source: manual-ar (title كشف حساب محاسبي, accounting account statement, p. 3); customer scope from the filter field customerCode
endpoints.method_basis: "You must put the report filters info in post parameter with key name [obj]" (p. 12)

inputs.name: obj
inputs.meaning: "obj string must be in Json format of the following class": AccountsheetFilters (customer variant)

fields.name: customerCode
fields.meaning: customer (account) code; whether any GL account code is accepted is unknown

notes: A read carried in a form POST body (p. 12).
Requiredness of the filter fields is not stated; the manual gives no field meanings (all inferred from names).
credit, debit and balance are returned as strings with an unknown number format; type is a string; start_date is undocumented; whether an opening-balance row exists is unknown (ISCO-38).
Date-range inclusivity and maximum range not stated (ISCO-21, ISCO-24). Salesman scoping not stated (ISCO-25).

endpoints.purpose: Insert a new voucher of any of the 13 documented types (order, invoice, return, receipt, payment, notes, journal, deliveries, stock-out).
endpoints.method_basis: "You must put the voucher info in post parameter with key name [obj]" (p. 13)

inputs.name: obj
inputs.meaning: "obj string must be in Json format of the following class": Voucher {header, items, cheqs, accounts}

rules.rule: header.type is one of VoucherTypes: Order=0, PurchaseDelivery=2, ReturnSalesInvoice=4, ReturnedPendingSalesDelivery=5, SalesInvoice=9, SalesDelivery=10, Stockout=12, InternalDelivery=16, Credit=22, Debit=23, Receipt=24, Payment=27, Journal=28
header.code is optional; if not sent Shamel assigns a number (اذا لم يتم ارسال رقم الحركة يتم اعطائها رقم من الشامل)
if header.code is sent "it must start with the following character": I, S, F, R, P, O, C, D, J, N, B, V by type; PurchaseDelivery has no letter
header.system_id: "value must be between 1000 and 2000" (purpose undocumented)
header.manual_code records the paper reference number if one exists (يتم استخدامه لتدوين رقم المرجعي الورقي ان وجد)
header.is_posted / is_printed: whether the voucher is entered as posted / printed (هل يتم ادخال حالة الحركة مرحلة / مطبوعة ام لا)
header.discount is the total invoice discount amount (قيمة الخصم الكلي للفاتورة); items[].discount is a percentage 0-100 (نسبة الخصم)
items[].vat is the tax amount for a quantity of 1 (قيمة الضريبة لكمية 1)
accounts is mandatory only in journal vouchers (اجبارية في سند القيد فقط)
items[].voucher_code and items[].name must NOT be filled on insert (لا يجب تعبئته في الادخال)
items[].pos starts from zero (يبدا من صفر)
items[].measure, items[].color and items[].serials are not used (غير مستخدم)
header.currency is a currency code, e.g. "NIS", "$" (كود العملة)

listed_in_overview.ar: طلبية مبيعات؛ سند جديد: فاتورة مبيعات، مردود مبيعات، ارسالية مشتريات، سند قبض، سند صرف، فاتورة من ارسالية، إشعار دائن، إشعار مدين، سند قيد، سند إخراج بضاعة، ارسالية داخلية، ارسالية مبيعات
listed_in_overview.en: sales order; new voucher: sales invoice, sales return, purchase delivery, receipt, payment, invoice from delivery, credit note, debit note, journal, goods-issue, internal delivery, sales delivery

notes: "Insert new voucher" (p. 13). "If the process succeeded, the refrenceId will contain the inserted code of the voucher" (p. 15). ErrorMessage is a string array here, unlike PostResponse.
Insert only: no update, delete, cancel or void endpoint; corrections presumably need a compensating voucher (e.g. credit note, return) or a manual fix in Shamel (inferred).

Overview (pp. 2-3) and enum (p. 15) disagree: "invoice from delivery" (فاتورة من ارسالية) has no enum value (inferred: SalesInvoice=9 with delivery_id / delivery_pos), and ReturnedPendingSalesDelivery=5 is not in the overview (ISCO-47).
Requiredness per voucher type is not documented, nor whether Shamel recomputes totals and VAT, checks stock, credit limits or stopped customers (ISCO-46, ISCO-47).
How receipts/payments carry the cash amount, and how an internal delivery names its destination store, are not stated (ISCO-47).
No idempotency; duplicate code/manual_code behaviour unknown; a retry after a timeout may double-post (ISCO-43). system_id meaning unknown (ISCO-44).
The name Post2 implies an older /Voucher/Post, which is undocumented (ISCO-50, ISCO-55). Undocumented values: payment_type, unit, debit_credit (ISCO-49).

endpoints.purpose: Get the delivery that has been prepared for the logged-in salesman.
endpoints.inputs_note: none documented; the salesman is implicit (inferred: the logged-in user's salesmanCode)
endpoints.returns: Voucher (delivery variant: header, items, cheqs; single object)
notes: "Get the delivery that is prepared to the salesman"; "It return object of Voucher class" (p. 16). No accounts list.
Behaviour with zero or several prepared deliveries, the voucher type returned, and whether the call changes state are unknown (ISCO-41).
Not listed in the p. 2 overview.

endpoints.purpose: Get the status of an order: not ready, ready, closed, sent partially or sent.

inputs.name: manual
inputs.meaning: printed only as "Fill Header[manual]"; presumably the order's manual_code (paper reference), not its voucher code

endpoints.returns: order status 0..4 (0 not ready, 1 ready, 2 closed, 3 sent partially, 4 sent); representation undocumented
notes: "Return the order status" (p. 16); English labels only.
Response shape (bare number or JSON), the result for an unknown value, duplicate manual codes and non-order types are undocumented (ISCO-42).
No way to get status by voucher code is documented (ISCO-42). Not listed in the p. 2 overview.

endpoints.purpose: Fetch one voucher (header, lines, cheques, accounts) by its code, optionally with the customer's balance at that time.

inputs.name: voucher_code
inputs.meaning: the voucher code (manual: "Set the voucher header in header[“voucher_code”]"); whether the prefix letter is included is not stated

inputs.name: getCustomerBalance
inputs.meaning: true returns "the customer balance at the invoice time. If the header is not set or set to false, 0 is returned."

notes: Path printed without a leading slash (p. 17) (ISCO-13).
The header name contains an underscore, which nginx and some proxies drop by default (ISCO-11).

Unlike GetVouchers, the balance wording lacks "(excluding the invoice itself)"; the balance field is presumably VoucherHeader.customer_balance (inferred) (ISCO-31). A requested 0 and a not-requested 0 look the same.
Not listed in the p. 2 overview.

endpoints.purpose: List vouchers in a date range, optionally for one customer and/or currency.
endpoints.purpose_source: inferred (from the filters object; the manual only says "return array of Voucher")

inputs.name: filters
inputs.meaning: JSON object in a request header: "add header[“filters”] that represent the following object"

fields.name: fromDate
fields.meaning: start of date range (yyyy-MM-dd per the global rule, p. 4); which date (voucher date or entry/update date) is not stated

fields.name: toDate
fields.meaning: end of date range (yyyy-MM-dd); inclusivity not stated

inputs.name: getCustomerBalance
inputs.meaning: true returns "the customer balance at the invoice time (excluding the invoice itself). If the header is not set or set to false, 0 is returned."

endpoints.returns: array of Voucher (which Voucher class is not stated; presumably the full one)
notes: Path printed without a leading slash (p. 17) (ISCO-13).
JSON inside a request header: header size limits and non-ASCII values are fragile (ISCO-11).
No voucher-type filter, no lookup by manual_code, no paging, no maximum range; whether dates are voucher dates or entry/update dates is unknown (ISCO-21, ISCO-23, ISCO-40).
Not listed in the p. 2 overview.

endpoints.purpose: Presumably a lightweight list of vouchers in a date range with amount, direction and the customer's balance at each voucher date; the manual does not explain it.
endpoints.purpose_source: inferred (from the short Voucher class; "Extra" is not explained)

inputs.name: filters
inputs.meaning: JSON object in a request header, same object as GetVouchers

fields.name: fromDate
fields.meaning: start of date range (yyyy-MM-dd per the global rule, p. 4); which date (voucher date or entry/update date) is not stated

fields.name: toDate
fields.meaning: end of date range (yyyy-MM-dd); inclusivity not stated

inputs.name: getCustomerBalance
inputs.meaning: true returns "the customer balance at the invoice time (excluding the invoice itself). If the header is not set or set to false, 0 is returned."

endpoints.returns: array of short Voucher (printed "public class Voucher"; a different class from the full one)
notes: Path printed without a leading slash (p. 17) (ISCO-13).
Which voucher types are included and what "extra" means are unknown; cr_dr values undocumented (ISCO-40, ISCO-49).
Same JSON-in-header and no-paging limits as GetVouchers (ISCO-11, ISCO-21). Not listed in the p. 2 overview.

endpoints.purpose: Insert a new cost center with a caller-chosen code.
endpoints.purpose_source: manual-ar (overview مركز تكلفة جديد, new cost center, p. 2) and the CostCenterDTO body; the endpoint text itself says "Insert new customer" (copy-paste error)
endpoints.method_basis: "You must put the customer info in post parameter with key name [obj]" (p. 18)

inputs.name: obj
inputs.meaning: "obj string must be in Json format of the following class": CostCenterDTO

matrix.notes: Full list only. units/division undocumented. Elsewhere currencies are referenced by code strings such as "NIS", "$" (p. 13).
Only the "latest 10" rates (p. 5); no currency/date filter, no history, no rate-on-date. 10 total vs per currency unclear. Vouchers carry their own rate (VoucherHeader.rate).
Two full lists; branches cannot be filtered by bank (join on bank_code, inferred). Path misspelled GetBanksBranchs.
id + name only. Towns/villages (Customer.town, كود القرية) have no list endpoint.

matrix.notes: Endpoint printed as a heading only (p. 6): inputs and response undocumented. Salesman also scopes GetCustomers (unless getAll=true) and GetDelivery.

related_reads: serials sold to a customer (/Item/GetItemsSerials customer header)
matrix.notes: No name search or paging. Create returns the Shamel-assigned code; the write model cannot set currency, credit limit or discount. Default inclusion of stopped customers unknown.

balance at a voucher's time (getCustomerBalance=true on Voucher/GetVoucher, GetVouchers, GetExtraVouchers)
matrix.notes: Current balances only; no as-of-date or history. pos/date/rate undocumented. Salesman scoping not stated.

No customer filter; whether global or per customer and whether customer is a code or name are unknown. Manual contradicts itself on which input is optional.

matrix.entity_ar_source: manual-ar singular مركز تكلفة (p. 2); plural is a translation
